newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE GAINS UP TO $7.50, BOOSTED BY U.S..
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE GAINS UP TO $7.50, BOOSTED BY U.S..

text.p: Healthy U.S. gasoline futures buying helped propel NWE gasoline several dollars higher on Wednesday, dealers said.
Swaps led the way with August gaining $7.50 trading at $218.00 and September trading at $200.50.
Wet eurograde barges traded $3.00 stonger at $218.50, $219.00 and $220.00.
The U.S. market showed renwed buying interest in response to U.S. data which showed a draw in gasoline stocks.
